text: GWM's business in Chile, which sponsors Chile Rugby, is run by Inchcape plc through Vehículos de Trabajo S.A.: the official GWM Chile website identifies itself as 'INCHCAPE AUTHORISED DISTRIBUTOR OF GREAT WALL MOTORS CHILE'.
short: In Chile GWM is operated by Inchcape's Vehículos de Trabajo S.A.

source.name: GWM Chile (gwm.cl): GWM y Chile Rugby: tres años de patrocinio y vamos por más (site footer)
source.quote: ©2025 VEHÍCULOS DE TRABAJO S.A., INCHCAPE DISTRIBUIDOR AUTORIZADO DE GREAT WALL MOTORS CHILE
source.note: The same blog post covers GWM's renewed sponsorship of Chile Rugby. The GWM brand itself is Great Wall Motor (China); in Chile the operation is Inchcape's.
